# Price the stop, not the pane count.

> Price a window cleaning job from panes, minutes per pane, stories, and travel time — then see the per-visit price, price per pane, effective hourly rate, and the walk-away number.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
